 UFC 334: Kevin Holland Expects New Contract to Be His Last
 MMA News UFC Video 
 Patrick Danna and Jay Anderson 
 November 11, 2026 
 New York — Kevin Holland returns to the cage at UFC 334 in New York this Saturday, where he takes on rising Serbian welterweight Uros Medic.
 Holland (20-15, 1NC) enters the match-up off a win over Randy Brown, with a new contract in hand. And despite Medic’s recent success, when it comes to the pairing, “I didn’t make much of it at all,” he stated during Wednesday’s media day, speaking with media outlets including Cageside Press. “I said yes.”
 To Holland, it sounded better than his fight with Jacobe Smith, which fell through earlier this year. And while Medic has suggested he’ll bring the fight come Saturday, “they always say a lot. Next thing you know, their head’s shooting for takedowns and sh*t like that. We’ll see what happens when it happens.”
 Holland, 34, did confirm on Wednesday that he has a new UFC deal. “Yup, new contract.” He’s suggested, in recent days, that it may very well be his last. “I would love for it to be.”
 “Quite a few” fights are on the deal, Holland added, saying that you can expect him to be around “for a little while.”
 After years in the UFC and considerable money made, the game plan remains the same for Kevin Holland. Win fights and make money. “That’s always the goal. Make all the bread I can, skip off into the sunlight.”
 And when the career is over? “Ride hoses, shoot sh*t, and f*ck bad b*tches. Same thing I always do.”
